selection_statistic: bounded blockwise Mann-Whitney / AUC, analytically studentized
multiplicity: search-wide max Z_rank over all k claims, one permutation mapping applied to every claim

needle_selection_rule.variable: treated_overlap on the final estimand population
needle_selection_rule.independence: 1H survivors play no part in needle selection

outer_noise: real MFE_10D with the sequence<->Y association destroyed first by permutation within the frozen blocks
injection: additive shift of the raw MFE_10D on the needle's treated episodes; never on U or R
detection: Z_rank(needle, delta) > p95( max_s Z_rank ) in the same inner-null world

denominator.form: exact combinatorial null variance with the rank-sum tie correction
denominator.recomputation: RECOMPUTED PER (needle, world, delta) on that injected multiset. Injection can break or create ties, and the conditional randomization variance must belong to the multiset it divides.
denominator.fixed_within: the 999 inner permutations of a (needle, world, delta) cell share that one SE
denominator.not_empirical: never estimated from the permutation numerator; this is not studentization by resampling

gate.method: exhaustive enumeration of all C(N,n_t) splits; no formula on the reference side
gate.grid: N 4..9 x every n_t x {no ties, one pair, one triple, two pairs, all identical}

engine.kernel: Numba fused segmented, prange over claims
engine.wasted_lanes_note: B=8 computes eight lanes for a six-delta grid. It is still the measured winner on t6: six lanes cost MORE (590.6 ms) than eight (531.0 ms), consistent with SIMD width. Measured, not chosen on theoretical efficiency.

workload_excludes: per-(needle, world, delta) rank rebuild and SE recomputation, outer-world setup, checkpoint I/O
frozen_and_may_not_change: worlds and permutations once the capability begins
needle identities now that they are sealed

remaining_gate_before_exposure.when: after SEALED Y ACCESS, before any outcome exposure
remaining_gate_before_exposure.what: the production analytic_sd built on the real block multisets must pass internal integrity checks
remaining_gate_before_exposure.forbidden: no claim's Z, theta or ranking may be printed by that gate

forbidden_claims: the 15m result confirms or validates any 1H claim
15m is an independent replication (same T5 episode universe, same 10-day outcome)
a lower band is more power
y_status: NO 15m Y ACCESS AT THE TIME OF THIS FREEZE
